definition: to tell someone what they should do
description: A bouldering wall built inside an old stone church with tall stained-glass windows, an iron candle chandelier and a carved wooden pulpit. A young man in a blue T-shirt stands on thick blue crash mats and points up at a yellow hold, telling the climber where to go. A young woman with a blonde ponytail, in a lilac sports top and black leggings, grabs it and climbs higher to a green hold, and he lowers his arm and claps. Two young women sit on the mats behind; one cheers with her arms up.

taps.phrase: to point up at the wall

taps.target: the woman in the red top
